service.method: SELECT USER_ID , EMAIL FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${houseCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${companyCode} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND (UPPER(USER_ID) = UPPER(${userIdOrEmail}) OR UPPER(EMAIL) = UPPER(${userIdOrEmail}))

SELECT PRGL.PR_USER_ID , PRGL.SIGN_PERSON_ID , PRGL.PURCHASER_ID , PRGL.SUBJECT , PRGL.PR_NUMBER , PRLN.PR_SEQ , PRLN.MATERIAL_NUMBER , PRLN.DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM SPRGL PRGL WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SPRLN PRLN WITH (NOLOCK) ON PRGL.HOUSE_CODE = PRLN.HOUSE_CODE AND PRGL.COMPANY_CODE = PRLN.COMPANY_CODE AND PRGL.PR_NUMBER = PRLN.PR_NUMBER WHERE PRGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND PRGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND PRGL.PR_NUMBER = ${PR_NUMBER} AND PRLN.PR_SEQ = ${PR_SEQ}

SELECT RQLN.HOUSE_CODE , RQLN.COMPANY_CODE , RQLN.RFQ_NUMBER , RQLN.RFQ_COUNT , RQLN.RFQ_SEQ , PRGL.PR_USER_ID , PRGL.SIGN_PERSON_ID , PRGL.PURCHASER_ID , PRGL.SUBJECT , PRGL.PR_NUMBER , RQSE.SELLER_CODE FROM SRQLN RQLN WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN SPRLN PRLN WITH (NOLOCK) ON RQLN.HOUSE_CODE = PRLN.HOUSE_CODE AND RQLN.COMPANY_CODE = PRLN.COMPANY_CODE AND RQLN.PR_NUMBER = PRLN.PR_NUMBER AND RQLN.PR_SEQ = PRLN.PR_SEQ AND RQLN.RFQ_NUMBER = ${RFQ_NUMBER} JOIN SPRGL PRGL WITH (NOLOCK) ON PRGL.HOUSE_CODE = PRLN.HOUSE_CODE AND PRGL.PR_NUMBER = PRLN.PR_NUMBER JOIN SRQSE RQSE WITH (NOLOCK) ON RQSE.HOUSE_CODE =RQLN.HOUSE_CODE AND RQSE.COMPANY_CODE = RQLN.COMPANY_CODE AND RQSE.RFQ_NUMBER = RQLN.RFQ_NUMBER AND RQSE.RFQ_COUNT = RQLN.RFQ_COUNT AND RQSE.RFQ_SEQ = RQLN.RFQ_SEQ

SELECT POLN.HOUSE_CODE , POLN.COMPANY_CODE , POLN.PO_NUMBER , POLN.PO_COUNT , POLN.PR_USER_ID , POGL.ADD_USER_ID , POGL.SUBJECT , '627741' AS SELLER_CODE FROM SPOLN POLN WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SPOGL POGL WITH (NOLOCK) ON POLN.HOUSE_CODE = POGL.HOUSE_CODE AND POLN.COMPANY_CODE = POGL.COMPANY_CODE AND POLN.PO_NUMBER = POGL.PO_NUMBER AND POLN.PO_COUNT = POGL.PO_COUNT AND POLN.PO_NUMBER = ${PO_NUMBER} GROUP BY POLN.HOUSE_CODE , POLN.COMPANY_CODE , POLN.PO_NUMBER , POLN.PO_COUNT , POLN.PR_USER_ID , POGL.ADD_USER_ID , POGL.SUBJECT

SELECT POLN.HOUSE_CODE , POLN.COMPANY_CODE , POLN.PO_NUMBER , POLN.PO_COUNT , POLN.PO_SEQ , POLN.PR_USER_ID , POLN.MATERIAL_NUMBER , POLN.DESCRIPTION_LOC , POGL.ADD_USER_ID , POGL.SUBJECT , '627741' AS SELLER_CODE FROM SPOLN POLN WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SPOGL POGL WITH (NOLOCK) ON POLN.HOUSE_CODE = POGL.HOUSE_CODE AND POLN.COMPANY_CODE = POGL.COMPANY_CODE AND POLN.PO_NUMBER = POGL.PO_NUMBER AND POLN.PO_COUNT = POGL.PO_COUNT AND POLN.PO_NUMBER = ${PO_NUMBER} AND POLN.PO_SEQ = ${PO_SEQ}

SELECT MOBILE_NO , EMAIL , USER_NAME FROM SSUPI SUPI WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SRQPI RQPI WITH (NOLOCK) ON SUPI.HOUSE_CODE = RQPI.HOUSE_CODE AND SUPI.COMPANY_CODE = RQPI.COMPANY_CODE AND SUPI.SELLER_CODE = RQPI.SELLER_CODE AND SUPI.SEQ = RQPI.SEQ WHERE RQPI.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND RQPI.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND RQPI.RFQ_NUMBER = ${RFQ_NUMBER} AND RQPI.RFQ_COUNT = ${RFQ_COUNT} GROUP BY MOBILE_NO , EMAIL , USER_NAME

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , RFQ_NUMBER , RFQ_COUNT , RFQ_SEQ , SELLER_CODE , MATERIAL_NUMBER , DESCRIPTION_LOC , SETTLE_FLAG , (SELECT PURCHASE_USER_ID FROM SRQGL WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = QTLN.HOUSE_CODE AND COMPANY_CODE = QTLN.COMPANY_CODE AND RFQ_NUMBER = QTLN.RFQ_NUMBER AND RFQ_COUNT = QTLN.RFQ_COUNT AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ) AS PURCHASE_USER_ID , (SELECT SUBJECT FROM SRQGL WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = QTLN.HOUSE_CODE AND COMPANY_CODE = QTLN.COMPANY_CODE AND RFQ_NUMBER = QTLN.RFQ_NUMBER AND RFQ_COUNT = QTLN.RFQ_COUNT AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ) AS SUBJECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SRQLN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = QTLN.HOUSE_CODE AND COMPANY_CODE = QTLN.COMPANY_CODE AND RFQ_NUMBER = QTLN.RFQ_NUMBER AND RFQ_COUNT = QTLN.RFQ_COUNT AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ) AS TOT_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SQTLN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = QTLN.HOUSE_CODE AND COMPANY_CODE = QTLN.COMPANY_CODE AND SELLER_CODE = QTLN.SELLER_CODE AND QTA_NUMBER = QTLN.QTA_NUMBER AND NVL(SETTLE_FLAG, 'N') = ${SETTLE_FLAG} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ) AS CNT FROM SQTLN QTLN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE RFQ_NUMBER || RFQ_COUNT || RFQ_SEQ IN (SELECT RFQ_NUMBER || RFQ_COUNT || RFQ_SEQ FROM SDRLN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EXEC_NUMBER = ${EXEC_NUMBER} AND EXEC_COUNT = ${EXEC_COUNT} ) AND SELLER_CODE = ${SELLER_CODE} AND NVL(SETTLE_FLAG, 'N') = ${SETTLE_FLAG} ORDER BY SETTLE_FLAG DESC , SELLER_CODE , RFQ_SEQ

SELECT POGL.HOUSE_CODE , POGL.COMPANY_CODE , POGL.PO_NUMBER , POGL.PO_COUNT , POGL.SELLER_CODE , POGL.SUBJECT , POGL.REMARK FROM SPOGL POGL WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SPOLN POLN WITH (NOLOCK) ON POGL.HOUSE_CODE = POLN.HOUSE_CODE AND POGL.COMPANY_CODE = POLN.COMPANY_CODE AND POGL.PO_NUMBER = POLN.PO_NUMBER AND POGL.PO_COUNT = POLN.PO_COUNT WHERE POGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND POGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND POGL.PO_NUMBER = ${PO_NUMBER} AND POGL.PO_COUNT = ${PO_COUNT} GROUP BY POGL.HOUSE_CODE , POGL.COMPANY_CODE , POGL.PO_NUMBER , POGL.PO_COUNT , POGL.SELLER_CODE , POGL.SUBJECT , POGL.REMARK

SELECT CTGL.CONT_NUMBER , CTGL.CONT_GL_SEQ , CTGL.SUBJECT , CTCU.CONT_COMPANY_CODE , CTCU.CONT_COMPANY_NAME , CTGL.CONT_USER_ID FROM SCTGL CTGL WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SCTCU CTCU WITH (NOLOCK) ON CTGL.HOUSE_CODE = CTCU.HOUSE_CODE AND CTGL.COMPANY_CODE = CTCU.COMPANY_CODE AND CTGL.CONT_NUMBER = CTCU.CONT_NUMBER AND CTGL.CONT_GL_SEQ = CTCU.CONT_GL_SEQ AND CTGL.CONT_SEQ = CTCU.CONT_SEQ AND CONT_SELLER_GUBUN = ${CONT_SELLER_GUBUN} WHERE CTGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CTGL.CONT_NUMBER = ${CONT_NUMBER} AND CTGL.CONT_GL_SEQ = ${CONT_GL_SEQ} AND CTGL.CONT_SEQ = ${CONT_SEQ}

SELECT IVGL.HOUSE_CODE , IVGL.COMPANY_CODE , IVGL.INV_NUMBER , IVGL.INV_COUNT , IVGL.SELLER_CODE , IVGL.SUBJECT , IVGL.INV_AMT , IVGL.PI_DIV , IVGL.PI_NUMBER , IVGL.PI_SEQ , PAYI.PI_TYPE , GETCODETEXT( IVGL.HOUSE_CODE, 'UX046', PAYI.PI_TYPE, '#session.LANGUAGE#') AS PI_TYPE_TEXT , IVLN.PO_NUMBER , IVLN.PO_COUNT , (SELECT INSPECTOR_ID FROM SPOGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = IVGL.HOUSE_CODE AND COMPANY_CODE = IVGL.COMPANY_CODE AND PO_NUMBER = IVLN.PO_NUMBER AND PO_COUNT = IVLN.PO_COUNT) AS INSPECTOR_ID FROM SIVGL IVGL WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SIVLN IVLN WITH (NOLOCK) ON IVLN.HOUSE_CODE = IVGL.HOUSE_CODE AND IVLN.COMPANY_CODE = IVGL.COMPANY_CODE AND IVLN.SELLER_CODE = IVGL.SELLER_CODE AND IVLN.INV_NUMBER = IVGL.INV_NUMBER AND IVLN.INV_COUNT = IVGL.INV_COUNT AND IVLN.DEL_KEY = IVGL.DEL_KEY INNER JOIN SPAYI PAYI WITH (NOLOCK) ON PAYI.HOUSE_CODE = IVGL.HOUSE_CODE AND PAYI.COMPANY_CODE = IVGL.COMPANY_CODE AND PAYI.PI_NUMBER = IVGL.PI_NUMBER AND PAYI.PI_DIV = IVGL.PI_DIV AND PAYI.PI_SEQ = IVGL.PI_SEQ INNER JOIN SPOGL POGL WITH (NOLOCK) ON POGL.HOUSE_CODE = IVLN.HOUSE_CODE AND POGL.COMPANY_CODE = IVLN.COMPANY_CODE AND POGL.PO_NUMBER = IVLN.PO_NUMBER AND POGL.PO_COUNT = IVLN.PO_COUNT WHERE IVGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND IVGL.SELLER_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND IVGL.INV_NUMBER = ${INV_NUMBER} AND IVGL.INV_COUNT = ${INV_COUNT} GROUP BY IVGL.HOUSE_CODE , IVGL.COMPANY_CODE , IVGL.INV_NUMBER , IVGL.INV_COUNT , IVGL.SELLER_CODE , IVGL.SUBJECT , IVGL.INV_AMT , IVGL.PI_DIV , IVGL.PI_NUMBER , IVGL.PI_SEQ , PAYI.PI_TYPE , IVLN.PO_NUMBER , IVLN.PO_COUNT

SELECT A.BILLSEQ , B.SELLER_CODE , A.SCOMPANY , B.TAX_USER_ID , BIGO FROM BILL_TRANS A WITH (NOLOCK) , (SELECT BILLSEQ , HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SELLER_CODE , TAX_USER_ID FROM STXLN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE BILLSEQ = ${BILLSEQ} GROUP BY BILLSEQ , HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SELLER_CODE , TAX_USER_ID ) B WHERE A.BILLSEQ = B.BILLSEQ

SELECT A.BILLSEQ , B.SELLER_CODE , B.TAX_USER_ID , BIGO FROM BILL_TRANS_NORMAL A WITH (NOLOCK) , (SELECT BILLSEQ , HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SELLER_CODE , TAX_USER_ID FROM STXLN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE BILLSEQ = ${BILLSEQ} GROUP BY BILLSEQ , HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SELLER_CODE , TAX_USER_ID ) B WHERE A.BILLSEQ = B.BILLSEQ

SELECT ADDR.EMAIL , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 AS MOBILE_NO , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT USMT WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR WITH (NOLOCK) ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'USER' WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${USER_ID}

SELECT NVL((SELECT EMAIL FROM SSUPI WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = SUGL.HOUSE_CODE AND SELLER_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE AND SEQ = '1'), ADDR.EMAIL) AS EMAIL , NVL((SELECT MOBILE_NO FROM SSUPI WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = SUGL.HOUSE_CODE AND SELLER_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE AND SEQ = '1'), ADDR.PHONE_NO2) AS MOBILE_NO , SUGL.SELLER_NAME_LOC FROM SSUGL SUGL WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SADDR ADDR WITH (NOLOCK) ON SUGL.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND SUGL.SELLER_CODE = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'SELLER' AND SUGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SUGL.SELLER_CODE = ${SELLER_CODE}

SELECT ADDR.EMAIL , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 AS MOBILE_NO , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT USMT WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR WITH (NOLOCK) ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'USER' WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${USER_ID}

SELECT NVL((SELECT EMAIL FROM SSUPI WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = SUGL.HOUSE_CODE AND SELLER_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE AND SEQ = '1'), ADDR.EMAIL) AS EMAIL , NVL((SELECT MOBILE_NO FROM SSUPI WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = SUGL.HOUSE_CODE AND SELLER_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE AND SEQ = '1'), ADDR.PHONE_NO2) AS MOBILE_NO , SUGL.SELLER_NAME_LOC FROM SSUGL SUGL WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SADDR ADDR WITH (NOLOCK) ON SUGL.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND SUGL.SELLER_CODE = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'SELLER' AND SUGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SUGL.SELLER_CODE = ${SELLER_CODE}

SELECT USMT.HOUSE_CODE, USMT.USER_ID, USMT.PASSWORD, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS USER_NAME, NVL( CASE WHEN UPPER(ADDR.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) THEN ADDR.EMAIL WHEN UPPER(USMT.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) THEN USMT.EMAIL ELSE ( SELECT DISTINCT t.EMAIL FROM SSUPI t LEFT OUTER JOIN SSUGL SUGL ON t.SELLER_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE WHERE USMT.USER_TYPE = 'S' AND NVL( t.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND UPPER(t.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) AND UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID}) ) END , 'A' ) AS EMAIL FROM SADDR ADDR FULL OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID})

SELECT ADDR.EMAIL , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS USER_NAME FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO WHERE UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID})

SELECT USMT.HOUSE_CODE, USMT.USER_ID, USMT.PASSWORD, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS USER_NAME, NVL( CASE WHEN UPPER(ADDR.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) THEN ADDR.EMAIL WHEN UPPER(USMT.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) THEN USMT.EMAIL ELSE ( SELECT DISTINCT t.EMAIL FROM SSUPI t LEFT OUTER JOIN SSUGL SUGL ON t.SELLER_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE WHERE USMT.USER_TYPE = 'S' AND NVL( t.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND UPPER(t.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) AND UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID}) ) END , 'A' ) AS EMAIL FROM SADDR ADDR FULL OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID})
